title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1967-01-14
lineage: CDR > EAC(secure) > Cool Edit(remove isolated pops) > mkwact(seekable)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of an early‑1967 three‑song set that delivers serious jam vibes with standout performances of Morning Dew, Viola Lee Blues and Good Morning Little Schoolgirl, despite a few vocal quirks.
ai_review.review: The recording preserves a raw, drum‑circle‑like energy from the January 14 1967 show, highlighted by extended jams and a flute‑driven third cut. While reviewers praise the musical moments and historic value, no concrete comments on sound quality were offered, leaving the audio picture assumed to be solid but unverified.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers gave high star ratings and emphasized strong musical moments; however, the lack of detailed recording feedback and a few low‑rating (0) entries keep confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on clarity or mix; assumed soundboard source with acceptable fidelity, though no specific strengths or flaws were noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A concise three‑song set that flows from a powerful opening with Morning Dew into jam‑heavy Viola Lee Blues and closes with a vocal‑centric Good Morning Little Schoolgirl, showcasing an early Dead exploratory vibe.
